root_cause: Native original Edge research logged SOURCE_HTML_UNAVAILABLE 10 times and repeatedly retried individual inaccessible company domains every 4 hours without diagnostic codes. As of 18:07 UTC it retried 2 due actions, obtained 0 readable sites and 0 new verified candidates, and 8 other source debts stayed due. The source reader collapsed HTTP denial, network timeout, oversized HTML, unsupported mime and rejected redirects to a single null, making owner-specific decisions impossible.
owner: original #116 research worker, #138 identity consumer, original-agent:commercial, agent-reliability
corrective_action: Keep original Edge and original records; record small stable fetch-failure class counts in original action evidence; exponential bounded next retry at 4/8/16/32/48h; retain canonical owner, source revision, actual successful page proof and legal send gate. Never replay expired emails.
prevention_rule: Source reader failure cannot be terminal success; must preserve false checked flag, real recorded failure classification, exact action, next scheduled bounded retry and independent consumer. Only successful official HTML with named published business mailto produces a non-sendable candidate.
